VolComp AI+ PROP — MNQ 5-Minute Scalping Lesson

A complete confluence-stack guide for prop scalping the Micro E-mini Nasdaq (MNQ)

Default prop confidence: 83%  ·  A+ tier: 88%

0How to use this lesson

Your chart is not one indicator — it is a confluence machine. The skill is to stop reading 50 labels and instead read 5 zones that answer 5 questions, in order. This document contains the diagrams, the step-by-step playbook, and the full VolComp AI+ PROP Pine Script (v6) source at the end — everything in one file.

1Panel Decoder — reading the VolComp AI+ PROP panel

RowReads likeMeaning
ACTACT BUY ^ 56% | PROP:BxV+E+H+Aggressive volume direction & %. The B/V/E/H tag = filter status (+ pass, x fail): Body, Volatility, EMA-proximity, HTF bias.
PROP ★A+ BUY ^ 90% (req 83/A+ 88)Your trigger. Green A+/B+ BUY ^ = long, red A+/B+ SELL v = short, gray SKIP = stand aside.
DOMDOM BUY ^ 67% | 3012Total volume direction, % and raw volume.
AIAI prob (up) % 55ML bias. >62 bullish, <38 bearish. Confirms — never triggers alone.
COACHCOACH HOLD =Wider signal engine. BUY / SELL / HOLD — confluence & exits.
STATESTATE FLATPosition tracker: FLAT / IN-LONG / IN-SHORT / EXIT.

2Screen Map — the 5 zones of your chart

  1. MTF Bias table — which way is the market leaning across timeframes?
  2. Level Rail (NQSPROP SL/Trigger/Entry/TP + SMAs) — exact entry/stop/target prices.
  3. Signal Cluster (ML/ICT/OB bias, scores, candlestick patterns) — is there a real edge?
  4. VolComp PROP panel — does volume confirm it (≥83%)?
  5. ORB Dashboard (risk, size, daily limit) — am I allowed to trade?

3The Confluence Stack — the decision funnel

  1. Direction — MTF table aligned (example: 1m/15m Strong Sell, Alignment Bearish → shorts only).
  2. Trend engine — MNQ ML PROP BIAS: SELL (20 SMA < 200 SMA) + ICT/OB sell bias agree.
  3. Trigger — PROP A+ ENTRY + VolComp PROP row red A+/B+ SELL ≥83% + NQSPROP trigger crossed.
  4. Price confirm — bearish candlestick (PinBar/Engulfing/Long-Upper-Shadow) + score 90–100% / RVI.
  5. Permission — ORB dashboard: risk OK, daily limit not hit, not STAND-DOWN.
  6. Execute — entry/stop/target straight off the NQSPROP level rail.

4Playbook & Guardrails

The routine (every 5-minute bar close)

  1. Check MTF Bias table → pick side. No alignment = wait.
  2. Confirm ML/SMA/ICT bias agrees (20 vs 200 SMA regime).
  3. Wait for PROP A+ / VolComp PROP row to fire your side ≥83%.
  4. Need a candlestick confirm + score 90%+ at a level.
  5. Dashboard green (risk ok, limit not hit) → take it.
  6. Enter/Stop/Target straight off the NQSPROP level rail.
Guardrails (do NOT break):
  • STAND DOWN / DAILY LIMIT HIT → stop for the day.
  • No green/red PROP row → no trade (volume isn't there).
  • Filters disagree → skip. Counter-trend signal → exit, don't hope.
  • Risk per trade fixed (~$200); A+ = full size, B+ = reduced, SKIP/WATCH = flat.
Grades: ELITE A+ / A+ = every layer aligned (full-conviction scalp). WATCH / NEXT / READY = setup forming, not yet valid (prepare, don't fire).
Coaching tip: keep this dense layout for study, but execute from a second clean chart — price + 20/200 SMA + the VolComp PROP row + the NQSPROP level rail. Same edge, zero clutter.

5The Indicator — VolComp AI+ PROP (Pine Script v6)

Paste this into TradingView → Pine Editor → Add to chart. Defaults are tuned for MNQ 5-minute prop scalping (83% prop confidence, EMA 20/200, no-reversal filters).

VolComp_AI_PROP_OPT.pine 
//@version=6
indicator("VolComp AI+ Coach [PROP-OPT | No-Reversal 5m]", shorttitle="VCAI-PROP", overlay=true, max_labels_count=250, max_lines_count=50, max_boxes_count=30)

// =============================================================================
// PROP TRADING OPTIMISATION NOTES (v1.1 — 20/200 EMA strategy)
// =============================================================================
// CHANGES vs original (all ADDITIVE — no existing setting/feature/AI logic altered):
//   v1.0
//   1. Fast EMA default: 8 -> 20  (aligns with your 20 SMA/200 SMA core strategy)
//   2. [NEW] Candle Body Filter   — rejects doji/indecision bars at entry
//   3. [NEW] ATR Compression Guard — blocks entries when volatility is compressed (chop)
//   4. [NEW] EMA-Touch Proximity Filter — price must be near (not far above) the 20 EMA
//   5. [NEW] HTF Bias Check (15m) — requires 15m DOM to agree with trade direction
//   6. [NEW] Consecutive Momentum Bars — B/NI entries require N rising/falling bars
//   7. [NEW] Prop Entry Quality Label — shows A+ / B+ / SKIP on each signal bar
//   8. [NEW] EMA 20/200 plotted on chart with clear visual
//   v1.1  (this version)
//   9. [FIX] Cleaned all panel glyphs (arrows/check marks) so volume rows render
//            correctly instead of garbled mojibake.
//  10. [NEW] PROP COLUMN: a dedicated panel row + A+/B+ BUY/SELL column that is
//            synced to YOUR required prop volume percentages. It only fires when
//            BOTH the dominant (DOM) and active (ACT) volume % meet your prop
//            buy/sell % thresholds AND the existing A/B/NI signal + quality
//            filters agree. This is the "volume-true" buy/sell column you asked
//            for — it reflects real volume dominance, not just the AI bias.
//  11. [NEW] Prop column alertconditions (A+/B+ buy & sell).
//   All original inputs, logic, alerts, state machine, AI orientation — UNTOUCHED.
// =============================================================================

//=============================================================================
// Helpers
//=============================================================================
safeDiv(float num, float den, float fallback) =>
    (na(num) or na(den) or den == 0.0) ? fallback : (num / den)

clamp(float x, float lo, float hi) =>
    math.min(math.max(x, lo), hi)

sigmoid(float z) =>
    1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-clamp(z, -12.0, 12.0)))

fmt2(float x) =>
    str.format("{0,number,0.00}", x)

f_attachMini(string base, string mini, string placement) =>
    string out = base
    if placement == "Prefix"
        out := mini + "  " + base
    else if placement == "Suffix"
        out := base + "  " + mini
    out

float atr14 = ta.atr(14)

txtSize() =>
    s = size.normal
    if tagTextSize == "Small"
        s := size.small
    else if tagTextSize == "Large"
        s := size.large
    s

f_upd(label lb, int x, float y, string txt, color bg, color tc, sz) =>
    label out = lb
    if na(out)
        out := label.new(x, y, txt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_label_left, color=bg, textcolor=tc, size=sz)
    else
        label.set_xy(out, x, y)
        label.set_text(out, txt)
        label.set_color(out, bg)
        label.set_textcolor(out, tc)
        label.set_size(out, sz)
    out

f_upd_plain(label lb, int x, float y, string txt, color tc, sz) =>
    label out = lb
    if na(out)
        out := label.new(x, y, txt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, style=label.style_none, color=color.new(color.black, 100), textcolor=tc, size=sz)
    else
        label.set_xy(out, x, y)
        label.set_text(out, txt)
        label.set_color(out, color.new(color.black, 100))
        label.set_textcolor(out, tc)
        label.set_size(out, sz)
    out

f_vertical_text(string txt) =>
    string out = ""
    int n = str.length(txt)
    for i = 0 to n - 1
        string ch = str.substring(txt, i, i + 1)
        out += (i == 0 ? "" : "\n") + ch
    out

f_del(label lb) =>
    label out = na
    if not na(lb)
        label.delete(lb)
    out

f_boxdel(box bx) =>
    box out = na
    if not na(bx)
        box.delete(bx)
    out

f_boxupd(box bx, int left, float top, int right, float bottom, color bg) =>
    box out = bx
    if na(out)
        out := box.new(left, top, right, bottom, xloc=xloc.bar_index, bgcolor=bg, border_color=color.new(color.black, 100))
    else
        box.set_lefttop(out, left, top)
        box.set_rightbottom(out, right, bottom)
        box.set_bgcolor(out, bg)
        box.set_border_color(out, color.new(color.black, 100))
    out

f_gap(string mode, float atrMult, int tickGap) =>
    float g = syminfo.mintick * float(tickGap)
    if mode == "ATR"
        g := atr14 * atrMult
    g

f_baseY(string preset, float manualPx, int lb) =>
    float hi = ta.highest(high, lb)
    float lo = ta.lowest(low, lb)
    float rng = hi - lo
    float y = manualPx
    if preset == "Upper"
        y := hi - (rng * 0.20)
    else if preset == "Middle"
        y := lo + (rng * 0.50)
    else if preset == "Lower"
        y := lo + (rng * 0.20)
    y

//=============================================================================
// LTF selection
//=============================================================================
string volumeSource = i_symbolBool == false ? syminfo.tickerid : i_symbolVolume
float currentTimeframe = timeframe.in_seconds(timeframe.period) / 60.0

string dynTf = i_tf1
if currentTimeframe > 30 and currentTimeframe <= 180
    dynTf := i_tf2
else if currentTimeframe > 180 and currentTimeframe <= 480
    dynTf := i_tf3
else if currentTimeframe > 480 and currentTimeframe <= 1440
    dynTf := i_tf4
else if currentTimeframe > 1440 and currentTimeframe <= 4320
    dynTf := i_tf5
else if currentTimeframe > 4320
    dynTf := i_tf6

ltfStats() =>
    float b  = i_source >= i_source[1] ? volume : 0.0
    float s  = i_source <  i_source[1] ? volume : 0.0
    float ba = (i_source >= i_source[1] and volume > volume[1]) ? volume : 0.0
    float sa = (i_source <  i_source[1] and volume > volume[1]) ? volume : 0.0
    [b, s, i_source, volume, ba, sa]

[buyVol, sellVol, _, _, buyVolActive, sellVolActive] = request.security_lower_tf(volumeSource, dynTf, ltfStats())

//=============================================================================
// Totals + smoothing base
//=============================================================================
float totalSellVolNorm = array.sum(sellVol)
float totalBuyVolNorm  = array.sum(buyVol)
float totalVolNorm     = totalSellVolNorm + totalBuyVolNorm

float totalSellVolANorm = array.sum(sellVolActive)
float totalBuyVolANorm  = array.sum(buyVolActive)
float totalVolANorm     = totalSellVolANorm + totalBuyVolANorm

smoothedValue(source, length) =>
    float out = na
    if i_smoothingType == "SMA"
        out := ta.sma(source, length)
    else if i_smoothingType == "EMA"
        out := ta.ema(source, length)
    else if i_smoothingType == "HMA"
        out := ta.hma(source, length)
    else if i_smoothingType == "RMA"
        out := ta.rma(source, length)
    else
        out := ta.wma(source, length)
    out

float volSma = smoothedValue(totalVolNorm, i_volSmaLength)

float totalSellVolRel  = safeDiv(totalSellVolNorm,  volSma, 0.0)
float totalBuyVolRel   = safeDiv(totalBuyVolNorm,   volSma, 0.0)
float totalVolRel      = totalSellVolRel + totalBuyVolRel

float totalSellVolARel = safeDiv(totalSellVolANorm, volSma, 0.0)
float totalBuyVolARel  = safeDiv(totalBuyVolANorm,  volSma, 0.0)
float totalVolARel     = totalSellVolARel + totalBuyVolARel

float totalVol     = i_relVol == false ? totalVolNorm     : totalVolRel
float totalBuyVol  = i_relVol == false ? totalBuyVolNorm  : totalBuyVolRel
float totalSellVol = i_relVol == false ? totalSellVolNorm : totalSellVolRel

float totalVolA     = i_relVol == false ? totalVolANorm     : totalVolARel
float totalBuyVolA  = i_relVol == false ? totalBuyVolANorm  : totalBuyVolARel
float totalSellVolA = i_relVol == false ? totalSellVolANorm : totalSellVolARel

float buyVolPerc   = safeDiv(totalBuyVol,  totalVol, 0.5)
float sellVolPerc  = safeDiv(totalSellVol, totalVol, 0.5)
float buyVolPercA  = safeDiv(totalBuyVolA,  totalVolA, 0.5)
float sellVolPercA = safeDiv(totalSellVolA, totalVolA, 0.5)

bool highBuyVol   = buyVolPerc  * 100 >= float(volThrEff)
bool highSellVol  = sellVolPerc * 100 >= float(volThrEff)
bool highBuyVolA  = buyVolPercA  * 100 >= float(volAThrEff)
bool highSellVolA = sellVolPercA * 100 >= float(volAThrEff)

bool ActiveVolDisagreement = (buyVolPercA > sellVolPercA and buyVolPerc < sellVolPerc) or (buyVolPercA < sellVolPercA and buyVolPerc > sellVolPerc)

//=============================================================================
// AI layer
//=============================================================================
float hlRange  = high - low
float closePos = hlRange != 0.0 ? (close - low) / hlRange : 0.5
float openPos  = hlRange != 0.0 ? (open - low) / hlRange : 0.5

bool engulfingUp   = high > high[1] and low < low[1] and closePos > 0.60
bool engulfingDown = high > high[1] and low < low[1] and closePos < 0.40
bool wickUp        = high < high[1] and low < low[1] and closePos > 0.60 and openPos > 0.40
bool wickDown      = high > high[1] and low > low[1] and closePos < 0.40 and openPos < 0.60

float barRange = high - low
bool expUp   = high > high[1] and low > low[1] and closePos > 0.70 and barRange > (barRange[1] * 1.5)
bool expDown = high < high[1] and low < low[1] and closePos < 0.30 and barRange > (barRange[1] * 1.5)

float relVolRatio = safeDiv(totalVolNorm, volSma, 1.0)
float vpi  = safeDiv(totalBuyVol, totalVol, 0.5) - safeDiv(totalSellVol, totalVol, 0.5)
float vpiA = safeDiv(totalBuyVolA, totalVolA, 0.5) - safeDiv(totalSellVolA, totalVolA, 0.5)

float x1 = clamp(vpi, -1.0, 1.0)
float x2 = clamp(vpiA, -1.0, 1.0)
float x3 = clamp(relVolRatio - 1.0, -2.0, 2.0) / 2.0
float x4 = ActiveVolDisagreement ? 1.0 : 0.0
float x5 = expUp ? 1.0 : expDown ? -1.0 : 0.0
float x6 = (wickUp or engulfingUp) ? 1.0 : (wickDown or engulfingDown) ? -1.0 : 0.0

var float w0 = 0.0
var float w1 = 0.0
var float w2 = 0.0
var float w3 = 0.0
var float w4 = 0.0
var float w5 = 0.0
var float w6 = 0.0

var float px1 = na
var float px2 = na
var float px3 = na
var float px4 = na
var float px5 = na
var float px6 = na

float zNow   = w0 + w1*x1 + w2*x2 + w3*x3 + w4*x4 + w5*x5 + w6*x6
float aiProb = sigmoid(zNow) * 100.0

if i_aiEnable and i_aiLearn and barstate.isconfirmed
    if not na(px1)
        float y = close > close[1] ? 1.0 : 0.0
        float zPrev = w0 + w1*px1 + w2*px2 + w3*px3 + w4*px4 + w5*px5 + w6*px6
        float pPrev = sigmoid(zPrev)
        float err = y - pPrev

        w0 *= i_aiDecay
        w1 *= i_aiDecay
        w2 *= i_aiDecay
        w3 *= i_aiDecay
        w4 *= i_aiDecay
        w5 *= i_aiDecay
        w6 *= i_aiDecay

        w0 += i_aiLR * err
        w1 += i_aiLR * err * px1
        w2 += i_aiLR * err * px2
        w3 += i_aiLR * err * px3
        w4 += i_aiLR * err * px4
        w5 += i_aiLR * err * px5
        w6 += i_aiLR * err * px6

        w0 := clamp(w0, -i_aiClip, i_aiClip)
        w1 := clamp(w1, -i_aiClip, i_aiClip)
        w2 := clamp(w2, -i_aiClip, i_aiClip)
        w3 := clamp(w3, -i_aiClip, i_aiClip)
        w4 := clamp(w4, -i_aiClip, i_aiClip)
        w5 := clamp(w5, -i_aiClip, i_aiClip)
        w6 := clamp(w6, -i_aiClip, i_aiClip)

    px1 := x1
    px2 := x2
    px3 := x3
    px4 := x4
    px5 := x5
    px6 := x6

bool aiBull = i_aiEnable and aiProb >= float(aiBullEff)
bool aiBear = i_aiEnable and aiProb <= float(aiBearEff)

//=============================================================================
// *** PROP QUALITY FILTERS — computed here, applied below ***
//=============================================================================

// EMA 20 / 200 (using user-defined fast/slow lengths — default 20/200)
float emaFast = ta.ema(close, i_abFastLen)
float emaSlow = ta.ema(close, i_abSlowLen)
bool trendUp = emaFast > emaSlow
bool trendDn = emaFast < emaSlow

// --- Filter 1: Candle Body Filter ---
// Entry candle must have a real body >= i_bodyMinPct x ATR(14)
// Eliminates doji, spinning tops, and indecision candles
float candleBody     = math.abs(close - open)
bool  bodyFilterPass = not i_propEnable or not i_bodyFilterOn or (candleBody >= atr14 * i_bodyMinPct)

// --- Filter 2: ATR Compression Guard ---
// Current ATR must be >= i_atrCompressRatio x its own SMA
// Eliminates entries during tight-range chop sessions where price reverses on the 1st tick
float atrSma         = ta.sma(atr14, i_atrCompressLen)
float atrRatio       = safeDiv(atr14, atrSma, 1.0)
bool  atrExpandPass  = not i_propEnable or not i_atrCompressOn or (atrRatio >= i_atrCompressRatio)

// --- Filter 3: EMA-20 Proximity (Pullback Entry Filter) ---
// Price must have touched/been within 1x ATR of the fast EMA in the last N bars
// Ensures you're entering on a pullback to EMA-20, not chasing an overextended move
// (Overextended = extended away from EMA -> high reversal risk)
float distFromEma20  = math.abs(close - emaFast)
float minDistN       = ta.lowest(distFromEma20, i_emaTouchBars)
bool  emaTouchPass   = not i_propEnable or not i_emaTouchOn or (minDistN <= atr14 * 1.0)

// --- Filter 4: HTF 15m DOM Bias ---
// Pull the 15m DOM direction from a security call
// Longs only when 15m DOM is BUY, Shorts only when 15m DOM is SELL
htf15mBuyVolPerc() =>
    float bv = i_source >= i_source[1] ? volume : 0.0
    float sv = i_source <  i_source[1] ? volume : 0.0
    float tot = bv + sv
    safeDiv(bv, tot, 0.5)

float htfBuyPct = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "15", htf15mBuyVolPerc(), lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_off)
bool  htfDomBull = htfBuyPct >= 0.50
bool  htfDomBear = htfBuyPct < 0.50
// Pass if HTF agrees or filter is off
bool  htfBiasPassLong  = not i_propEnable or not i_htfBiasOn or htfDomBull
bool  htfBiasPassShort = not i_propEnable or not i_htfBiasOn or htfDomBear

// --- Filter 5: Consecutive Momentum Bars (for B/NI grade trades) ---
// Requires N consecutive higher closes (longs) or lower closes (shorts)
// Applied only to B-grade and NI signals — keeps A-grade untouched
int consLen = math.max(i_consBarLen, 2)
bool consUpOk   = not i_propEnable or not i_consBarOn or ta.rising(close, consLen - 1)
bool consDnOk   = not i_propEnable or not i_consBarOn or ta.falling(close, consLen - 1)

// --- Combined prop gate per direction ---
// A-trades: body + ATR expand + EMA proximity + HTF bias (no consecutive bar req — A-trades are strongest)
bool propGateLongA  = bodyFilterPass and atrExpandPass and emaTouchPass and htfBiasPassLong
bool propGateShortA = bodyFilterPass and atrExpandPass and emaTouchPass and htfBiasPassShort
// B/NI-trades: all of the above + consecutive bars
bool propGateLongBNI  = propGateLongA  and consUpOk
bool propGateShortBNI = propGateShortA and consDnOk

//=============================================================================
// A/B + NI stacks (ORIGINAL LOGIC — prop gate applied as additional AND)
//=============================================================================
bool tf5m = timeframe.isminutes and timeframe.multiplier == 5
bool tfOkAB = i_abOnly5m ? tf5m : true
bool tfOkNI = i_niOnly5m ? tf5m : true

bool relOkAB = abMinRelVolEff <= 0.0 ? true : (relVolRatio >= abMinRelVolEff)

float dirScore = clamp(vpiA * 100.0, -100.0, 100.0)
float relBoost = clamp((relVolRatio - 1.0) * 20.0, 0.0, 20.0)
float confBuy  = clamp(aiProb + (dirScore * 0.20) + relBoost, 0.0, 100.0)
float confSell = clamp((100.0 - aiProb) - (dirScore * 0.20) + relBoost, 0.0, 100.0)

bool domBuy = totalBuyVol >= totalSellVol
bool actBuy = totalBuyVolA >= totalSellVolA

bool buyAnom  = highBuyVol or highBuyVolA
bool sellAnom = highSellVol or highSellVolA

bool niRelOk  = niMinRelVolEff <= 0.0 ? true : (relVolRatio >= niMinRelVolEff)
bool vpiARise = ta.rising(vpiA, niSlopeLenEff)
bool vpiAFall = ta.falling(vpiA, niSlopeLenEff)
bool aDataNotNa = na(totalVolA) == false and totalVolA > 0

// Original A/B/NI conditions unchanged — prop gate added as last condition
bool aLongLive  = i_abEnable and tfOkAB and relOkAB and buyAnom  and domBuy and actBuy and (not ActiveVolDisagreement) and (aiProb >= float(abStrongBullEff)) and (confBuy  >= float(abMinConfAEff)) and (not i_abUseTrend or trendUp) and propGateLongA
bool aShortLive = i_abEnable and tfOkAB and relOkAB and sellAnom and (not domBuy) and (not actBuy) and (not ActiveVolDisagreement) and (aiProb <= float(abStrongBearEff)) and (confSell >= float(abMinConfAEff)) and (not i_abUseTrend or trendDn) and propGateShortA

bool bLongLive  = i_abEnable and tfOkAB and relOkAB and buyAnom  and (aiBull or aiProb >= float(aiBullEff)) and (confBuy  >= float(abMinConfBEff)) and (not i_abUseTrend or trendUp) and propGateLongBNI
bool bShortLive = i_abEnable and tfOkAB and relOkAB and sellAnom and (aiBear or aiProb <= float(aiBearEff)) and (confSell >= float(abMinConfBEff)) and (not i_abUseTrend or trendDn) and propGateShortBNI

bool niLongLive  = i_niEnable and tfOkNI and aDataNotNa and niRelOk and (vpiA >=  niThrEff) and vpiARise and propGateLongBNI
bool niShortLive = i_niEnable and tfOkNI and aDataNotNa and niRelOk and (vpiA <= -niThrEff) and vpiAFall and propGateShortBNI

bool aLongConf   = aLongLive and barstate.isconfirmed
bool aShortConf  = aShortLive and barstate.isconfirmed
bool bLongConf   = bLongLive and barstate.isconfirmed
bool bShortConf  = bShortLive and barstate.isconfirmed
bool niLongConf  = niLongLive and barstate.isconfirmed
bool niShortConf = niShortLive and barstate.isconfirmed

prioStack(bool _aL, bool _aS, bool _bL, bool _bS, bool _niL, bool _niS) =>
    int st = 0
    if i_abOnePerBar
        if _aL
            st := 1
        else if _aS
            st := 2
        else if _bL
            st := 3
        else if _bS
            st := 4
        else if _niL
            st := 7
        else if _niS
            st := 8
    st

int sigLive = prioStack(aLongLive, aShortLive, bLongLive, bShortLive, niLongLive, niShortLive)
int sigConf = prioStack(aLongConf, aShortConf, bLongConf, bShortConf, niLongConf, niShortConf)

sigNameFromType(int _t) =>
    string out = "-"
    if _t == 1
        out := "A L"
    else if _t == 2
        out := "A S"
    else if _t == 3
        out := "B L"
    else if _t == 4
        out := "B S"
    else if _t == 7
        out := "NI L"
    else if _t == 8
        out := "NI S"
    out

string sigLiveName = sigNameFromType(sigLive)

//=============================================================================
// Coach decision
//=============================================================================
bool buyFromAB_live  = (sigLive == 1 or sigLive == 3)
bool sellFromAB_live = (sigLive == 2 or sigLive == 4)
bool buyFromAB_conf  = (sigConf == 1 or sigConf == 3)
bool sellFromAB_conf = (sigConf == 2 or sigConf == 4)

bool buyFromDiamonds  = highBuyVol
bool sellFromDiamonds = highSellVol
bool buyFromActive    = highBuyVolA
bool sellFromActive   = highSellVolA
bool buyFromAI        = aiBull
bool sellFromAI       = aiBear

coachPick(_abBuy, _abSell) =>
    bool cb = false
    bool cs = false
    if coachMode == "A/B stack (exact)"
        cb := _abBuy
        cs := _abSell
    else if coachMode == "Threshold diamonds (buy/sell)"
        cb := buyFromDiamonds
        cs := sellFromDiamonds
    else if coachMode == "Active thresholds (buy/sell)"
        cb := buyFromActive
        cs := sellFromActive
    else if coachMode == "AI bias only"
        cb := buyFromAI
        cs := sellFromAI
    else
        cb := _abBuy ? true : ((aiBull and buyAnom) or (highBuyVolA and aiBull) or (highBuyVol and aiBull))
        cs := _abSell ? true : ((aiBear and sellAnom) or (highSellVolA and aiBear) or (highSellVol and aiBear))
    [cb, cs]

[coachBuyLive, coachSellLive] = coachPick(buyFromAB_live, sellFromAB_live)
[coachBuyConf, coachSellConf] = coachPick(buyFromAB_conf, sellFromAB_conf)
bool coachHoldLive = not coachBuyLive and not coachSellLive
bool coachHoldConf = not coachBuyConf and not coachSellConf

//=============================================================================
// State machine
//=============================================================================
var int  tradeState = 0
var bool didEnterLong  = false
var bool didEnterShort = false
var bool didExitLong   = false
var bool didExitShort  = false
var string exitText    = ""

didEnterLong := false
didEnterShort := false
didExitLong := false
didExitShort := false
exitText := ""

if stateEnable and barstate.isconfirmed
    bool domActAgainstLong  = (not domBuy) and (not actBuy)
    bool domActAgainstShort = domBuy and actBuy
    bool aiAgainstLong  = aiProb < 50.0
    bool aiAgainstShort = aiProb > 50.0

    if tradeState == 1
        bool exitByOpp = exitOnOpposite and coachSellConf
        bool exitByDA  = exitOnDomActFlipEff and domActAgainstLong
        bool exitByAI  = exitOnAiFlipEff and aiAgainstLong
        if exitByOpp or exitByDA or exitByAI
            didExitLong := true
            exitText := exitByOpp ? "EXIT LONG (opp)" : exitByDA ? "EXIT LONG (DA)" : "EXIT LONG (AI)"
            tradeState := (exitByOpp and exitMode == "Flip") ? -1 : 0
            if (exitByOpp and exitMode == "Flip")
                didEnterShort := true

    else if tradeState == -1
        bool exitByOpp = exitOnOpposite and coachBuyConf
        bool exitByDA  = exitOnDomActFlipEff and domActAgainstShort
        bool exitByAI  = exitOnAiFlipEff and aiAgainstShort
        if exitByOpp or exitByDA or exitByAI
            didExitShort := true
            exitText := exitByOpp ? "EXIT SHORT (opp)" : exitByDA ? "EXIT SHORT (DA)" : "EXIT SHORT (AI)"
            tradeState := (exitByOpp and exitMode == "Flip") ? 1 : 0
            if (exitByOpp and exitMode == "Flip")
                didEnterLong := true

    if tradeState == 0
        if coachBuyConf
            tradeState := 1
            didEnterLong := true
        else if coachSellConf
            tradeState := -1
            didEnterShort := true

//=============================================================================
// Shapes + Background
//=============================================================================
bool useLiveShapes = (shapeTiming == "Live preview (intrabar)")
bool shapeBuy  = showShapes and (useLiveShapes ? coachBuyLive : coachBuyConf)
bool shapeSell = showShapes and (useLiveShapes ? coachSellLive : coachSellConf)

plotshape(shapeBuy,  title="Coach BUY",  style=shape.triangleup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.lime, 0), size=size.tiny, text="BUY",  textcolor=color.black)
plotshape(shapeSell, title="Coach SELL", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.red,  0), size=size.tiny, text="SELL", textcolor=color.white)

// *** Original Prop Entry Quality Labels (UNCHANGED) ***
// A+ = A-grade signal passed all prop filters (highest conviction, do not skip)
// B+ = B or NI grade signal passed all prop filters
bool isAgrade = (sigLive == 1 or sigLive == 2)
bool isBNIgrade = (sigLive == 3 or sigLive == 4 or sigLive == 7 or sigLive == 8)
bool anySignalLive = sigLive != 0

bool showAPlusLong  = i_showQualityLabel and anySignalLive and isAgrade   and coachBuyLive
bool showAPlusShort = i_showQualityLabel and anySignalLive and isAgrade   and coachSellLive
bool showBPlusLong  = i_showQualityLabel and anySignalLive and isBNIgrade and coachBuyLive
bool showBPlusShort = i_showQualityLabel and anySignalLive and isBNIgrade and coachSellLive

plotshape(showAPlusLong,  title="A+ Long",  style=shape.labelup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.lime,   15), size=size.small, text="A+", textcolor=color.black,  offset=-1)
plotshape(showAPlusShort, title="A+ Short", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.red,    15), size=size.small, text="A+", textcolor=color.white,  offset=-1)
plotshape(showBPlusLong,  title="B+ Long",  style=shape.labelup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.teal,   15), size=size.small, text="B+", textcolor=color.white,  offset=-1)
plotshape(showBPlusShort, title="B+ Short", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.maroon, 15), size=size.small, text="B+", textcolor=color.white,  offset=-1)

//=============================================================================
// *** NEW: PROP VOLUME % COLUMN — synced to your prop buy/sell percentages ***
// This is the "volume-true" buy/sell column. It only flags A+/B+ when BOTH the
// dominant (DOM) and active (ACT) volume % meet the % your prop rules require,
// AND the existing signal grade + quality filters agree. Reflects real volume.
//=============================================================================
float propDomBuyPct  = buyVolPerc   * 100.0   // dominant BUY volume %
float propDomSellPct = sellVolPerc  * 100.0   // dominant SELL volume %
float propActBuyPct  = buyVolPercA  * 100.0   // active BUY volume %
float propActSellPct = sellVolPercA * 100.0   // active SELL volume %

// Required volume % satisfied for each direction (DOM and ACT must both agree)
bool propBuyVolReq  = (propDomBuyPct  >= float(i_propBuyReqPct))  and (propActBuyPct  >= float(i_propBuyReqPct))
bool propSellVolReq = (propDomSellPct >= float(i_propSellReqPct)) and (propActSellPct >= float(i_propSellReqPct))

// A+ = A-grade live signal + prop gate + dominant vol% >= A+ requirement
bool propAPlusBuyLive  = anySignalLive and isAgrade   and coachBuyLive  and propBuyVolReq  and (propDomBuyPct  >= float(i_propAPlusReqPct))
bool propAPlusSellLive = anySignalLive and isAgrade   and coachSellLive and propSellVolReq and (propDomSellPct >= float(i_propAPlusReqPct))
// B+ = B/NI-grade live signal + prop gate + base vol% requirement
bool propBPlusBuyLive  = anySignalLive and isBNIgrade and coachBuyLive  and propBuyVolReq
bool propBPlusSellLive = anySignalLive and isBNIgrade and coachSellLive and propSellVolReq

bool propBuySig  = propAPlusBuyLive  or propBPlusBuyLive
bool propSellSig = propAPlusSellLive or propBPlusSellLive

// Confirmed variants (for alerts)
bool propAPlusBuyConf  = propAPlusBuyLive  and barstate.isconfirmed
bool propAPlusSellConf = propAPlusSellLive and barstate.isconfirmed
bool propBPlusBuyConf  = propBPlusBuyLive  and barstate.isconfirmed
bool propBPlusSellConf = propBPlusSellLive and barstate.isconfirmed

string propGradeTxt = propAPlusBuyLive ? "A+ BUY" : propAPlusSellLive ? "A+ SELL" : propBPlusBuyLive ? "B+ BUY" : propBPlusSellLive ? "B+ SELL" : "SKIP"
float propShownPct  = propBuySig ? propDomBuyPct : propSellSig ? propDomSellPct : math.max(propDomBuyPct, propDomSellPct)

// *** Chart markers for the volume-synced PROP column (separate from originals) ***
plotshape(i_propColOn and i_propColLabels and propAPlusBuyLive,  title="PROP A+ BUY",  style=shape.labelup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.lime,   0), size=size.normal, text="PA+", textcolor=color.black, offset=0)
plotshape(i_propColOn and i_propColLabels and propAPlusSellLive, title="PROP A+ SELL", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.red,    0), size=size.normal, text="PA+", textcolor=color.white, offset=0)
plotshape(i_propColOn and i_propColLabels and propBPlusBuyLive,  title="PROP B+ BUY",  style=shape.labelup,   location=location.belowbar, color=color.new(color.teal,   0), size=size.small,  text="PB+", textcolor=color.white, offset=0)
plotshape(i_propColOn and i_propColLabels and propBPlusSellLive, title="PROP B+ SELL", style=shape.labeldown, location=location.abovebar, color=color.new(color.maroon, 0), size=size.small,  text="PB+", textcolor=color.white, offset=0)

color bgCol = na
if tintChartBg
    bgCol := coachBuyLive ? color.new(color.green, 90) : coachSellLive ? color.new(color.red, 90) : color.new(color.yellow, 92)
bgcolor(bgCol)

//=============================================================================
// *** EMA 20 / 200 Plots ***
// Plotted clearly so you can visually confirm pullback-to-EMA entries
//=============================================================================
plot(emaFast, title="EMA 20 (Fast / Prop Core)", color=color.new(color.orange, 0),   linewidth=2)
plot(emaSlow, title="EMA 200 (Slow / Trend)",    color=color.new(color.white,  40),  linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

// EMA 20/200 ribbon fill — green above (bullish structure), red below (bearish)
ema20above200 = emaFast >= emaSlow
p1 = plot(emaFast, display=display.none)
p2 = plot(emaSlow, display=display.none)
fill(p1, p2, color = ema20above200 ? color.new(color.green, 88) : color.new(color.red, 88), title="EMA 20/200 Ribbon")

// *** ATR Compression visual — background tint when in chop (no-entry zone) ***
bool inChop = i_propEnable and i_atrCompressOn and not atrExpandPass
bgcolor(inChop ? color.new(color.gray, 93) : na, title="Chop Zone (ATR Compressed)")

//=============================================================================
// Panel row text
//=============================================================================
float dominantVolPerc  = domBuy ? (buyVolPerc * 100.0) : (sellVolPerc * 100.0)
float dominantVolAPerc = actBuy ? (buyVolPercA * 100.0) : (sellVolPercA * 100.0)

float domAbsNorm = domBuy ? totalBuyVolNorm : totalSellVolNorm
float actAbsNorm = actBuy ? totalBuyVolANorm : totalSellVolANorm

string domPctTxt = str.tostring(int(math.round(dominantVolPerc, 0))) + "%"
string actPctTxt = str.tostring(int(math.round(dominantVolAPerc, 0))) + "%"

string domSideTxt  = domBuy ? "DOM BUY" : "DOM SELL"
string domArrowTxt = domBuy ? "^" : "v"
string actSideTxt  = actBuy ? "ACT BUY" : "ACT SELL"
string actArrowTxt = actBuy ? "^" : "v"

string coachArrowTxt = coachBuyLive ? "^" : coachSellLive ? "v" : "="
string coachCoreTxt  = coachBuyLive ? "BUY" : coachSellLive ? "SELL" : "HOLD"

// VC text tag
string vcDomRounded = miniVCNumberMode == "Single digit"
     ? str.tostring(int(math.round(dominantVolPerc / 10.0, 0)))
     : str.tostring(int(math.round(dominantVolPerc, 0)))

string vcActRounded = miniVCNumberMode == "Single digit"
     ? str.tostring(int(math.round(dominantVolAPerc / 10.0, 0)))
     : str.tostring(int(math.round(dominantVolAPerc, 0)))

string vcActiveState = actBuy ? (ActiveVolDisagreement ? "(+)" : "+") : (ActiveVolDisagreement ? "(-)" : "-")
string vcFlagTxt = miniVCShowFlags ? (((highBuyVol or highSellVol or highBuyVolA or highSellVolA) ? "*" : "") + (ActiveVolDisagreement ? "D" : "")) : ""
string vcMiniTxt = (miniVCShowTag ? "VC " : "") + "[" + vcDomRounded + "|" + vcActiveState + vcActRounded + vcFlagTxt + "]"

// *** Prop filter status appended to ACT row ***
string propStatusTxt = i_propEnable ? (" | PROP:" + (bodyFilterPass ? "B+" : "Bx") + (atrExpandPass ? "V+" : "Vx") + (emaTouchPass ? "E+" : "Ex") + (htfBiasPassLong or htfBiasPassShort ? "H+" : "Hx")) : ""

string rowActBase   = tagPad + actSideTxt + " " + actArrowTxt + " " + actPctTxt + " [" + styleTag + "]" + propStatusTxt
string rowTotalBase = tagPad + "TOTAL VOL " + fmt2(totalVolNorm) + " | RV " + fmt2(relVolRatio) + "x"
string rowDomBase   = tagPad + domSideTxt + " " + domArrowTxt + " " + domPctTxt + " | " + fmt2(domAbsNorm)
string rowAIBase    = tagPad + "AI prob (up) % " + fmt2(aiProb)
string rowCoachBase = tagPad + "COACH " + coachCoreTxt + " " + coachArrowTxt + " " + domPctTxt + " (" + sigLiveName + ")"

// *** NEW: PROP column row text ***
string propArrowTxt = propBuySig ? "^" : propSellSig ? "v" : "="
string rowPropBase  = tagPad + "PROP " + propGradeTxt + " " + propArrowTxt + " " + str.tostring(int(math.round(propShownPct, 0))) + "% (req " + str.tostring(i_propBuyReqPct) + "/A+ " + str.tostring(i_propAPlusReqPct) + ")"

string stateTxt = "STATE FLAT"
if not stateEnable
    stateTxt := "STATE OFF"
else
    if didExitLong or didExitShort
        stateTxt := "STATE " + exitText
    else if tradeState == 1
        stateTxt := "STATE IN-LONG"
    else if tradeState == -1
        stateTxt := "STATE IN-SHORT"
    else
        stateTxt := "STATE FLAT"

string rowStateBase = tagPad + stateTxt

string rowAct   = f_attachMini(rowActBase, vcMiniTxt, miniVCPlacement)
string rowTotal = miniVCRepeatAllRows ? f_attachMini(rowTotalBase, vcMiniTxt, miniVCPlacement) : rowTotalBase
string rowDom   = miniVCRepeatAllRows ? f_attachMini(rowDomBase, vcMiniTxt, miniVCPlacement)   : rowDomBase
string rowAI    = rowAIBase
string rowCoach = miniVCRepeatAllRows ? f_attachMini(rowCoachBase, vcMiniTxt, miniVCPlacement) : rowCoachBase
string rowProp  = miniVCRepeatAllRows ? f_attachMini(rowPropBase, vcMiniTxt, miniVCPlacement)  : rowPropBase
string rowState = miniVCRepeatAllRows ? f_attachMini(rowStateBase, vcMiniTxt, miniVCPlacement) : rowStateBase

//=============================================================================
// Row colors
//=============================================================================
color totalBg = color.new(color.gray, tagAlpha)
color totalStripe = color.new(color.gray, stripeAlpha)

color actBg = color.new(actBuy ? cActBuy : cActSell, tagAlpha)
color domBg = color.new(domBuy ? cDomBuy : cDomSell, tagAlpha)
color aiBg  = color.new(cAI, tagAlpha)

color coachBg = color.new(coachBuyLive ? color.green : coachSellLive ? color.red : color.yellow, tagAlpha)
color coachTc = (coachBuyLive or coachSellLive) ? color.white : color.black

// *** NEW: PROP row colors ***
color propBg = color.new(propBuySig ? color.green : propSellSig ? color.red : color.gray, tagAlpha)
color propTc = (propBuySig or propSellSig) ? color.white : color.silver
color propStripe = color.new(propBuySig ? color.green : propSellSig ? color.red : color.gray, stripeAlpha)

color stateBg = color.new(color.gray, tagAlpha)
color stateTc = color.white
color stateStripeCol = color.new(color.gray, stripeAlpha)

if stateEnable
    if didExitLong or didExitShort
        stateBg := color.new(cExit, tagAlpha)
        stateStripeCol := color.new(cExit, stripeAlpha)
        stateTc := color.white
    else if tradeState == 1
        stateBg := color.new(color.green, tagAlpha)
        stateStripeCol := color.new(color.green, stripeAlpha)
        stateTc := color.white
    else if tradeState == -1
        stateBg := color.new(color.red, tagAlpha)
        stateStripeCol := color.new(color.red, stripeAlpha)
        stateTc := color.white

color actStripe   = color.new(actBuy ? cActBuy : cActSell, stripeAlpha)
color domStripe   = color.new(domBuy ? cDomBuy : cDomSell, stripeAlpha)
color aiStripe    = color.new(cAI, stripeAlpha)
color coachStripe = color.new(coachBuyLive ? color.green : coachSellLive ? color.red : color.yellow, stripeAlpha)

//=============================================================================
// Anchored (Table) panel
//=============================================================================
pos = position.top_right
if panelPos == "Top Left"
    pos := position.top_left
else if panelPos == "Top Center"
    pos := position.top_center
else if panelPos == "Top Right"
    pos := position.top_right
else if panelPos == "Center Left"
    pos := position.middle_left
else if panelPos == "Center"
    pos := position.middle_center
else if panelPos == "Center Right"
    pos := position.middle_right
else if panelPos == "Bottom Left"
    pos := position.bottom_left
else if panelPos == "Bottom Center"
    pos := position.bottom_center
else if panelPos == "Bottom Right"
    pos := position.bottom_right

// Row order — PROP placed at the TOP, directly UNDER the ACT buy/sell row, so the
// prop BUY/SELL/SKIP call is the first thing you read (no scanning to the bottom).
// TOTAL VOL row removed by request. Order: ACT -> PROP -> DOM -> AI -> COACH -> STATE
int rAct = 0
int rPrp = i_propColOn ? 1 : -1
int rDom = i_propColOn ? 2 : 1
int rAi  = i_propColOn ? 3 : 2
int rCch = i_propColOn ? 4 : 3
int rSta = i_propColOn ? 5 : 4

var table t = na
if panelMode == "Anchored (Table)" and na(t)
    t := table.new(pos, showStripes ? 2 : 1, 6, border_width=0)

ts = txtSize()
string stripeChar = " "

if showPanel and panelMode == "Anchored (Table)" and barstate.islast and not na(t)
    if showStripes
        table.cell(t, 0, rAct, stripeChar, text_color=color.new(color.white, 100), bgcolor=actStripe, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 1, rAct, rowAct,     text_color=color.white,                bgcolor=actBg,     text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)

        if i_propColOn
            table.cell(t, 0, rPrp, stripeChar, text_color=color.new(color.white, 100), bgcolor=propStripe, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
            table.cell(t, 1, rPrp, rowProp,    text_color=propTc,                     bgcolor=propBg,     text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)

        table.cell(t, 0, rDom, stripeChar, text_color=color.new(color.white, 100), bgcolor=domStripe, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 1, rDom, rowDom,     text_color=color.white,                bgcolor=domBg,     text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)

        table.cell(t, 0, rAi, stripeChar, text_color=color.new(color.white, 100), bgcolor=aiStripe, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 1, rAi, rowAI,      text_color=color.white,                bgcolor=aiBg,     text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)

        table.cell(t, 0, rCch, stripeChar, text_color=color.new(color.white, 100), bgcolor=coachStripe, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 1, rCch, rowCoach,   text_color=coachTc,                    bgcolor=coachBg,     text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)

        table.cell(t, 0, rSta, stripeChar, text_color=color.new(color.white, 100), bgcolor=stateStripeCol, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 1, rSta, rowState,   text_color=stateTc,                    bgcolor=stateBg,        text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
    else
        table.cell(t, 0, rAct, rowAct, text_color=color.white, bgcolor=actBg, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        if i_propColOn
            table.cell(t, 0, rPrp, rowProp, text_color=propTc, bgcolor=propBg, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 0, rDom, rowDom,   text_color=color.white, bgcolor=domBg,   text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 0, rAi,  rowAI,    text_color=color.white, bgcolor=aiBg,    text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 0, rCch, rowCoach, text_color=coachTc,     bgcolor=coachBg, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)
        table.cell(t, 0, rSta, rowState, text_color=stateTc,     bgcolor=stateBg, text_size=ts, text_halign=text.align_left)

//=============================================================================
// Floating panel labels — single panel only
//=============================================================================
var label p1ActS = na
var label p1Act  = na
var label p1TotS = na
var label p1Tot  = na
var label p1DomS = na
var label p1Dom  = na
var label p1AiS  = na
var label p1Ai   = na
var label p1CchS = na
var label p1Cch  = na
var label p1PrpS = na
var label p1Prp  = na
var label p1StaS = na
var label p1Sta  = na

//=============================================================================
// VC candle replica boxes
//=============================================================================
var box rep1Other = na
var box rep1Dom   = na
var box rep1Act   = na
var label rep1Pct = na

if barstate.islast
    bool useFloat = showPanel and panelMode == "Floating (Price-Level)"

    if not (useFloat and float1Enable)
        p1ActS := f_del(p1ActS)
        p1Act  := f_del(p1Act)
        p1TotS := f_del(p1TotS)
        p1Tot  := f_del(p1Tot)
        p1DomS := f_del(p1DomS)
        p1Dom  := f_del(p1Dom)
        p1AiS  := f_del(p1AiS)
        p1Ai   := f_del(p1Ai)
        p1CchS := f_del(p1CchS)
        p1Cch  := f_del(p1Cch)
        p1PrpS := f_del(p1PrpS)
        p1Prp  := f_del(p1Prp)
        p1StaS := f_del(p1StaS)
        p1Sta  := f_del(p1Sta)

    if not (showVCReplica and useFloat and float1Enable)
        rep1Other := f_boxdel(rep1Other)
        rep1Dom   := f_boxdel(rep1Dom)
        rep1Act   := f_boxdel(rep1Act)
        rep1Pct   := f_del(rep1Pct)

    if useFloat and float1Enable
        float man1   = float1AnchorPx == 0.0 ? close : float1AnchorPx
        float baseY1 = float1Preset == "Manual" ? man1 : f_baseY(float1Preset, man1, float1Lookback)
        float gap1   = f_gap(float1GapMode, float1GapATR, float1GapTicks)
        int x1_      = bar_index + float1XBars
        int xs1      = x1_ - 1

        // Row stacking (TOTAL removed): Act, [Prop], Dom, AI, Coach, State
        // PROP sits directly under ACT so the prop buy/sell call is read first.
        float yAct1 = baseY1
        float yPrp1 = baseY1 - gap1 * 1.0
        float yDom1 = baseY1 - gap1 * (i_propColOn ? 2.0 : 1.0)
        float yAi1  = baseY1 - gap1 * (i_propColOn ? 3.0 : 2.0)
        float yCch1 = baseY1 - gap1 * (i_propColOn ? 4.0 : 3.0)
        float ySta1 = baseY1 - gap1 * (i_propColOn ? 5.0 : 4.0)
        float yBottom1 = ySta1   // lowest row for replica anchoring

        // TOTAL row removed by request — make sure any old total labels are gone
        p1TotS := f_del(p1TotS)
        p1Tot  := f_del(p1Tot)

        if showStripes
            p1ActS := f_upd(p1ActS, xs1, yAct1, " ", actStripe,      color.new(color.white, 100), size.tiny)
            if i_propColOn
                p1PrpS := f_upd(p1PrpS, xs1, yPrp1, " ", propStripe, color.new(color.white, 100), size.tiny)
            else
                p1PrpS := f_del(p1PrpS)
            p1DomS := f_upd(p1DomS, xs1, yDom1, " ", domStripe,      color.new(color.white, 100), size.tiny)
            p1AiS  := f_upd(p1AiS,  xs1, yAi1,  " ", aiStripe,       color.new(color.white, 100), size.tiny)
            p1CchS := f_upd(p1CchS, xs1, yCch1, " ", coachStripe,    color.new(color.white, 100), size.tiny)
            p1StaS := f_upd(p1StaS, xs1, ySta1, " ", stateStripeCol, color.new(color.white, 100), size.tiny)
        else
            p1ActS := f_del(p1ActS)
            p1DomS := f_del(p1DomS)
            p1AiS  := f_del(p1AiS)
            p1CchS := f_del(p1CchS)
            p1PrpS := f_del(p1PrpS)
            p1StaS := f_del(p1StaS)

        p1Act := f_upd(p1Act, x1_, yAct1, rowAct,   actBg,   color.white, ts)
        if i_propColOn
            p1Prp := f_upd(p1Prp, x1_, yPrp1, rowProp, propBg, propTc, ts)
        else
            p1Prp := f_del(p1Prp)
        p1Dom := f_upd(p1Dom, x1_, yDom1, rowDom,   domBg,   color.white, ts)
        p1Ai  := f_upd(p1Ai,  x1_, yAi1,  rowAI,    aiBg,    color.white, ts)
        p1Cch := f_upd(p1Cch, x1_, yCch1, rowCoach, coachBg, coachTc,      ts)
        p1Sta := f_upd(p1Sta, x1_, ySta1, rowState, stateBg, stateTc,      ts)

        if showVCReplica
            float totalAbsRep = math.max(totalVolNorm, 0.0)
            float domAbsRep   = math.min(domAbsNorm, totalAbsRep)
            float actAbsRep   = math.min(actAbsNorm, domAbsRep)
            float domOnlyRep  = math.max(domAbsRep - actAbsRep, 0.0)
            float otherRep    = math.max(totalAbsRep - domAbsRep, 0.0)
            float totalSafe   = math.max(totalAbsRep, 0.000001)

            int repRight1 = x1_ - vcReplicaGapBars
            int repLeft1  = repRight1 - vcReplicaWidthBars

            float repBottom1 = yBottom1 - gap1 * 0.20
            float repHeight1 = gap1 * vcReplicaSpanRows
            float repTop1    = repBottom1 + repHeight1

            float hAct1   = repHeight1 * (actAbsRep / totalSafe)
            float hDom1   = repHeight1 * (domOnlyRep / totalSafe)
            float lvlActTop1 = repBottom1 + hAct1
            float lvlDomTop1 = lvlActTop1 + hDom1

            color repActCol1 = actBuy ? cActBuy : cActSell
            color repDomCol1 = domBuy ? cDomBuy : cDomSell

            rep1Act   := f_boxupd(rep1Act,   repLeft1, lvlActTop1, repRight1, repBottom1, repActCol1)
            rep1Dom   := f_boxupd(rep1Dom,   repLeft1, lvlDomTop1, repRight1, lvlActTop1, repDomCol1)
            rep1Other := f_boxupd(rep1Other, repLeft1, repTop1,    repRight1, lvlDomTop1, vcReplicaGray)

            int repMidX1 = int(math.round((repLeft1 + repRight1) * 0.5))
            float repMidY1 = repBottom1 + (repHeight1 * 0.50)
            string repPctTxt = f_vertical_text(str.tostring(int(math.round(dominantVolPerc, 0))) + "%")

            rep1Pct := f_upd_plain(rep1Pct, repMidX1, repMidY1, repPctTxt, color.white, size.large)

//=============================================================================
// Alerts
//=============================================================================
bool useLiveAlerts = (alertTiming == "Live preview (intrabar)")
bool buyAlert  = useLiveAlerts ? coachBuyLive  : coachBuyConf
bool sellAlert = useLiveAlerts ? coachSellLive : coachSellConf
bool holdAlert = useLiveAlerts ? coachHoldLive : coachHoldConf

alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and buyAlert,  "Coach BUY",  "buy")
alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and sellAlert, "Coach SELL", "sell")

var int prevConfirmedState = 0
var int lastConfirmedState = 0
int stateConfSimple = coachBuyConf ? 1 : coachSellConf ? -1 : 0
if barstate.isconfirmed
    prevConfirmedState := lastConfirmedState
    lastConfirmedState := stateConfSimple
bool holdOnChange = barstate.isconfirmed and (stateConfSimple == 0) and (prevConfirmedState != 0)

bool holdCond = false
if enableHoldAlerts and holdAlert
    if holdAlertMode == "Every bar"
        holdCond := true
    else
        holdCond := useLiveAlerts ? false : holdOnChange

alertcondition(holdCond, "Coach HOLD", "hold")

alertcondition(enableStateAlerts and didEnterLong,  "STATE: Enter Long",  "enter_long")
alertcondition(enableStateAlerts and didEnterShort, "STATE: Enter Short", "enter_short")
alertcondition(enableStateAlerts and didExitLong,   "STATE: Exit Long",   "exit_long")
alertcondition(enableStateAlerts and didExitShort,  "STATE: Exit Short",  "exit_short")

alertcondition(enableThresholdAlerts and highBuyVol,   "Coach: High Buy Volume Threshold",  "High buy volume threshold exceeded.")
alertcondition(enableThresholdAlerts and highSellVol,  "Coach: High Sell Volume Threshold", "High sell volume threshold exceeded.")
alertcondition(enableThresholdAlerts and highBuyVolA,  "Coach: High Active Buy Threshold",  "High active buy volume threshold exceeded.")
alertcondition(enableThresholdAlerts and highSellVolA, "Coach: High Active Sell Threshold", "High active volume threshold exceeded.")
alertcondition(enableThresholdAlerts and ActiveVolDisagreement, "Coach: Volume/Active Divergence", "Volume/active volume divergence detected.")

// *** Original Prop-grade alerts (grade only) ***
alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and buyAlert  and isAgrade,   "PROP A-grade BUY",   "prop_a_grade_buy")
alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and sellAlert and isAgrade,   "PROP A-grade SELL",  "prop_a_grade_sell")
alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and buyAlert  and isBNIgrade, "PROP B-grade BUY",   "prop_b_grade_buy")
alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and sellAlert and isBNIgrade, "PROP B-grade SELL",  "prop_b_grade_sell")

// *** NEW: Volume-synced PROP column alerts (fire only when DOM+ACT vol% meet your prop %) ***
bool propBuyAlert  = useLiveAlerts ? propAPlusBuyLive  : propAPlusBuyConf
bool propSellAlert = useLiveAlerts ? propAPlusSellLive : propAPlusSellConf
bool propBBuyAlert  = useLiveAlerts ? propBPlusBuyLive  : propBPlusBuyConf
bool propBSellAlert = useLiveAlerts ? propBPlusSellLive : propBPlusSellConf

alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and i_propColOn and propBuyAlert,   "PROP COLUMN A+ BUY",  "prop_col_a_plus_buy")
alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and i_propColOn and propSellAlert,  "PROP COLUMN A+ SELL", "prop_col_a_plus_sell")
alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and i_propColOn and propBBuyAlert,  "PROP COLUMN B+ BUY",  "prop_col_b_plus_buy")
alertcondition(enableBuySellAlerts and i_propColOn and propBSellAlert, "PROP COLUMN B+ SELL", "prop_col_b_plus_sell")
